record.title: Missing training_scope enforcement and client-controlled mode gate in POST /api/v1/va/<va_sid>/social-autopsy and POST /api/v1/va/<va_sid>/narrative-qa
record.description: POST /api/v1/va/<va_sid>/social-autopsy (save_social_autopsy in app/routes/api/so.py:54-239) and POST /api/v1/va/<va_sid>/narrative-qa (save_narrative_qa in app/routes/api/nqa.py:53-212) do not call training_scope.resolve(...) or training_scope.sid_allowed(va_sid) and do not filter VaAllocations by va_allocation_training. In addition, save_social_autopsy and save_narrative_qa branch between reviewer access checks and coder access checks using client-supplied va_actiontype while persisting VaSocialAutopsyAnalysis and VaNarrativeAssessment rows keyed by (va_sid, user_id, payload_version_id), and require_coding_access (app/utils/va_permission/va_permission_11_require_coding_access.py:34-37) skips the VaAllocations lookup when an admin sends va_actiontype='vademo_start_coding' on a demo-training submission.
record.claimed_root_cause: save_social_autopsy (app/routes/api/so.py:56-95) and save_narrative_qa (app/routes/api/nqa.py:55-89) omit training_scope.resolve, training_scope.sid_allowed(va_sid), and VaAllocations.va_allocation_training filters, and select between reviewer authorization/feature gates and coder authorization/feature gates from client-supplied va_actiontype while writing to per-(va_sid, user_id, payload_version_id) artifact tables and allowing admin vademo_start_coding requests on demo submissions without an allocation.

trace.description: Authenticated POST /api/v1/va/<va_sid>/social-autopsy handler reads JSON body and client-supplied va_actiontype.

Computes is_reviewer_session from va_actiontype in {'vastartreviewing', 'varesumereviewing'} and dispatches to either the reviewer permission/allocation check (lines 71-82) or require_coding_access(va_sid) (line 84).

Verifies coding access: allows admin demo saves when va_actiontype == 'vademo_start_coding' and is_demo_training_submission(va_sid) is true (lines 34-37), otherwise requires can(current_user, Action.CODE, va_sid) and an active VaAllocation.coding row for (current_user.user_id, va_sid) (lines 51-69).
Acquires a row lock on the submission and re-verifies the caller's active reviewing or coding allocation before mutating artifacts.
Creates or updates the active VaSocialAutopsyAnalysis record for (va_sid, current_user.user_id, active_payload_version.payload_version_id).

evidence.description: Module contract specifies that training_scope partitions list, count, and allocation-acquisition endpoints between the TRN01 training project and real projects based on ?training=.
Coding allocations set va_allocation_training = training_scope.is_training_sid(va_sid) from the submission's project at allocation creation time.
Reviewer allocations set va_allocation_training = training_scope.is_training_sid(va_sid) from the submission's project at allocation creation time.

Reviewer branch enforces both live grant check can(current_user, Action.REVIEW, va_sid) and an active VaAllocation.reviewing row for (current_user.user_id, va_sid), then re-confirms under lock at lines 153-155.

Reviewer branch in save_narrative_qa likewise enforces can(current_user, Action.REVIEW, va_sid) and an active VaAllocation.reviewing row for (current_user.user_id, va_sid), re-confirmed under lock at lines 124-126.

Coder branch enforces can(current_user, Action.CODE, va_sid) and an active VaAllocation.coding row for (current_user.user_id, va_sid), and is re-invoked under submission lock at app/routes/api/so.py:157-158 and app/routes/api/nqa.py:128-129.
Finalizing coder COD deactivates the coder's VaAllocation.coding row before the submission transitions to reviewer_eligible.
A reviewer allocation can only be created when the submission workflow state is WORKFLOW_REVIEWER_ELIGIBLE, preventing concurrent active coding and reviewing allocations on the same va_sid.

social_autopsy_enabled(project, 'vareview') requires both project.social_autopsy_enabled and project.reviewer_social_autopsy_enabled, so reviewer social autopsy is never enabled when project.social_autopsy_enabled is false.

Unit test test_admin_demo_save_on_a_demo_submission_needs_no_allocation explicitly verifies as intended behavior that an admin sending va_actiontype='vademo_start_coding' on a demo_training_enabled project can save without an allocation row.

record.reason: Source code refutes all three parts of the candidate: (1) training_scope separates the TRN01 training project from real projects on list, count, and allocation-acquisition routes (app/services/training_scope.py:5-18; app/routes/api/coding.py:179,193; app/routes/api/reviewing.py:116-118). Once a submission is allocated, va_sid belongs to a single project and VaAllocations.va_allocation_training is deterministically derived from training_scope.is_training_sid(va_sid) (app/services/coder_workflow_service.py:885; app/services/reviewer_coding_service.py:442). Because save_social_autopsy and save_narrative_qa require both a live grant check via can(current_user, Action.CODE or Action.REVIEW, va_sid) and an active VaAllocations row matching that exact va_sid (app/routes/api/so.py:71-86,152-161; app/routes/api/nqa.py:73-88,123-132), omitting ?training= or VaAllocations.va_allocation_training does not allow cross-scope access or saves on unallocated submissions (and the Expo client intentionally calls these per-submission endpoints without ?training= in mobile/digitva-collect/src/workspace/api.ts:247-248). (2) Although va_actiontype selects between the reviewer and coder branches, each branch independently enforces both its action grant (Action.REVIEW vs Action.CODE) and an active allocation of the matching type (VaAllocation.reviewing vs VaAllocation.coding) on va_sid before and after locking the submission. A submission cannot simultaneously have active coding and reviewing allocations because coder finalization deactivates the coding allocation (app/services/coder_cod_service.py:999) before reviewer allocation is permitted in WORKFLOW_REVIEWER_ELIGIBLE (app/services/reviewer_coding_service.py:412), so a caller cannot flip va_actiontype to bypass reviewer_social_autopsy_enabled or coder_social_autopsy_enabled during an active session. (3) Allowing an admin with va_actiontype='vademo_start_coding' on a demo_training_enabled submission to save without an allocation in require_coding_access (app/utils/va_permission/va_permission_11_require_coding_access.py:34-37) is documented and tested design for ephemeral admin demo testing (tests/routes/test_narrative_qa.py:374-385), and any resulting row is restricted to demo projects, scoped to the admin's own user_id, and stamped with demo_expires_at (app/routes/api/so.py:180,198; app/routes/api/nqa.py:157,181).
